name: 徐曉萱
objective:
This course enables the students know the fundamental concepts in materials science, modern theory of solids, and semiconductor physics/Devices. The introduction of electronic devices and semiconductor processing used in the current semiconductor industry are also included.
(Course taught in English)
schedule:
1. Introduction 
2. Elementary Materials Science Concepts 
3. Electrical  Conduction in Solids 
4. Elementary Quantum Physics
5. Fundamentals of Semiconductor 
6. Semiconductor Devices (LED and Solar Cell) 
7. Materials processing and fabrication
scorePolicy:
Midterm Exam: 40%
Final Exam: 40 %
Class Participation: 20% (Homework, Classwork, Attendance)
materials:
1. Principles of Electronic Materials and Devices, Third Edition, S. O. Kasap, McGraw-Hill, 2006 ISBN 007-124458-1 
2.Semiconductor Physics & Devices Basic Principles 4/E, D. A. Neamen,  McGrawHill, 2012, ISBN：9780071089029
延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）

2. 第 17-18 週彈性學習/(共 6 小時)：

(2) 評量比例：學習成果檢核佔平時成績 30%。 

1. GAI is conditionally permitted. Its use in assignments must be disclosed; undisclosed use will receive no credit.
